title: How to Add a Logo Watermark to Video with Codex MCP and Medux
description: This guide turns the screen-recorded workflow into a clean, publish-ready tutorial. Codex reads the request, locates the input video and logo, calls Medux through MCP, and returns a new MP4 with the logo placed in the top-right corner.
operation: This guide turns the screen-recorded workflow into a clean, publish-ready tutorial. Codex reads the request, locates the input video and logo, calls Medux through MCP, and returns a new MP4 with the logo placed in the top-right corner.
prompt: Use Medux to add logo2.png to sample.mp4. Resize the logo to an appropriate size and place it in the top-right corner of the video.
